content: Hiya y'all! I have Lean formalizations of the large sieve, Selberg almost-orthogonality, and a rectangle argument principle. I used Claude Code to assist in developing these, but they are Kernel-checked, with axiom closures verified. I searched through mathlib as well as several other systems, found no equivalencies, and was wondering if it duplicated anybody else's work, and if it does not, would it be something y'all would like? Happy to share the full declaration list or a repo link if that helps.
AI code is rarely in the correct generality and style for upstreaming to Mathlib, especially if you have not previously contributed

That's fair, and I'd much rather verify than assume. Would it help if I posted a single self-contained statement first, say the almost-orthogonality inequality, so you can ensure the generality and style are workable before anyone looks at the rest?
